def VTask.strongDownwardInduction {α : Type u_1} {p : Multiset α → Sort u_3} {n : ℕ} 
    (H : (t₁ : Multiset α) → ({t₂ : Multiset α} → t₂.card ≤ n → t₁ < t₂ → p t₂) → t₁.card ≤ n → p t₁) 
    (s : Multiset α) (h : s.card ≤ n) : p s :=
match h with
| nat.zero =>
  H ∅ (λ _, false.elim) (by decide)
| nat.succ m =>
  let IH : ∀ s' : Multiset α, s'.card ≤ m → p s' :=
    VTask.strongDownwardInduction H
  H s (IH ∘ fun s'' => by decide) (by decide)
